title: Mansell Boat Rentals
specs: Boating in Acadia National Park area with views of 17 mountains and islands
Trips can include seals, osprey nests, sightseeing, or lunch at islands
Captain license or boat registration of same size required
Must be 30 years of age or returning customers
All onboard must be able to walk on the boat
Sail or powerboat rentals require captain's license, AS certification, or extensive sailing experience
First-time customers must be checked out on the water
Maximum 4 to 6 people onboard depending on boat
includes: Boat rigging and explanation of sail area and operation
gap: Exact age minimum for all customers not stated beyond 30 years or returning customers
blurb: Rent motorboats limited to the Acadia National Park area including Southwest Harbor, Somes Sound, Northeast Harbor, Seal Harbor, and the Cranberry Islands. Rentals require a 48-hour notice and are from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Boats accommodate 4 to 6 people who must be able to walk on the boat.
extraNote: 48-hour notice required · $2,500 damage deposit required, cash or personal check preferred; VISA or MasterCard accepted · Gasoline not included in rental price · Right to refuse rentals to unqualified customers · Reservations made a few days prior when weather is known · Pier at Mansell House, 135 Shore Road, Manset, Southwest Harbor, Maine
